title: The Crib Commander
style: 3D animated movie still in the style of a Pixar film, cute expressive characters with big eyes, exaggerated funny facial expressions, vibrant colors, soft cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16

riya.look: Young woman, early 20s, light wheatish skin, long wavy dark-brown hair in a ponytail, cheerful face, wearing a simple blue denim dress over a white t-shirt, small silver earrings.

adi.look: Adorable baby boy, 1 year old, chubby cheeks, big curious eyes, light skin, wearing a bright yellow romper with a tiny dinosaur print.

scenes.image: [[riya]] standing at the front door, eyes wide with a mix of shock and amusement, holding a small purse. The door is slightly ajar. Sunny afternoon.
scenes.speaker: riya
scenes.line: Mujhe laga main baby sit kar rahi hoon, par I was wrong!
scenes.say: मुझे लगा मैं बेबी सिट कर रही हूँ, पर आई वाज़ रॉन्ग!

scenes.image: [[riya]] smiling brightly at a woman (off-screen) at the door, stepping into a living room with colourful baby toys scattered around. Bright and warm.
scenes.speaker: riya
scenes.line: Aunty ne kaha, Adi thoda fuss karega.
scenes.say: आंटी ने कहा, आदि थोड़ा फ़स करेगा।

scenes.image: [[adi]] sitting on a colorful playmat, stacking soft blocks, looking innocent. [[riya]] in the background, listening politely.
scenes.speaker: riya

scenes.image: [[adi]] looks up from his blocks, making a loud 'goo-goo-ga-ga' sound, pointing towards the TV remote. [[riya]] looks at him, confused.
scenes.speaker: riya
scenes.line: Par Aunty jaate hi, Adi ne shuru kiya.
scenes.say: पर आंटी जाते ही, आदि ने शुरू किया।

scenes.image: [[riya]] holding a baby bottle, trying to offer it to [[adi]], who pushes it away, still babbling urgently and pointing.
scenes.speaker: riya

scenes.image: Close-up of [[adi]] on the floor, red-faced, pointing a tiny finger at a stack of mail on the coffee table, making a demanding 'bwa-bwa-bwa!' sound.
scenes.speaker: riya
scenes.line: Usne bottle fenki, aur zor se bola.
scenes.say: उसने बॉटल फेंकी, और ज़ोर से बोला।

scenes.image: [[riya]] kneeling, eyes widening as she looks at [[adi]], a realization dawning on her face, like she just understood a foreign language.
scenes.speaker: riya
scenes.line: Suddenly, mujhe sab samajh aane laga.
scenes.say: सडनली, मुझे सब समझ आने लगा।

scenes.image: [[adi]] with a tiny serious expression, looking at [[riya]], raising a small fist. There's an imaginary thought bubble showing a tiny 'boss' symbol.
scenes.speaker: adi

scenes.image: [[riya]] picking up the TV remote from the sofa, looking at [[adi]] with disbelief and a chuckle. Adi watches her expectantly.
scenes.speaker: adi

scenes.image: [[riya]] sitting on the floor with [[adi]] next to her, looking at a utility bill in her hand, with Adi looking over her shoulder, pointing at numbers.
scenes.speaker: riya
scenes.line: Usne mujhe bills check karne ko kaha.
scenes.say: उसने मुझे बिल्स चेक करने को कहा।

scenes.image: [[riya]]'s face, a mix of amusement and astonishment, looking directly at the camera, as if sharing a secret.
scenes.speaker: riya
scenes.line: Pata chala, yeh toh ghar ka boss hai!
scenes.say: पता चला, ये तो घर का बॉस है!

scenes.image: [[adi]] pointing towards the kitchen, making a 'mama-ma-ma' sound, while [[riya]] pulls out a notepad and pen.
scenes.speaker: adi

scenes.image: Close-up of [[riya]]'s hand writing items on a notepad, while [[adi]]'s tiny hand points to the paper, looking satisfied.
scenes.speaker: riya
scenes.line: Aunty ke orders toh dummy the.
scenes.say: आंटी के ऑर्डर्स तो डमी थे।

scenes.image: [[riya]] smiling mischievously, looking at the door where the parents would return, then back at [[adi]] who is now playing calmly again.
scenes.speaker: riya
scenes.line: Parents ko kuch pata hi nahi.
scenes.say: पेरेंट्स को कुछ पता ही नहीं।

scenes.image: [[adi]] leaning back in his high chair, a tiny smirk on his face, giving a 'thumbs up' gesture to [[riya]] who stands in front of him, holding a completed checklist.
scenes.speaker: adi

scenes.image: [[riya]] shrugging playfully at the camera, holding up the grocery list and an imaginary 'salary request' note, a look of 'what can you do?' on her face.
scenes.speaker: riya
scenes.line: Aapka baby bhi secret boss hai kya?
scenes.say: आपका बेबी भी सीक्रेट बॉस है क्या?

caption: My Babysitter Understood Baby Talk... He Was The Boss! 😂
yt_title: My Babysitter Understood Baby Talk... He Was The Boss! 😂
description:
This babysitter thought she was in charge, but the baby had other plans.
You won't believe the secret demands this little boss was making!
Does your baby run the house too?
comment_question: Does your baby run the house too?
